name: Gokyo Lakes Trek
sub_region: Solukhumbu District, Koshi Province (Sagarmatha National Park, Khumbu Pasang Lhamu Rural Municipality)

difficulty.notes: Non-technical teahouse trek; altitude is the main difficulty (sleeping at about 4,790 m at Gokyo; steep 1.5-3 h climb to Gokyo Ri at 5,357 m). Quieter than the EBC trail.

duration_days.basis: Full trip Kathmandu-Kathmandu (about 10 trekking days Lukla-Lukla)
duration_days.notes: Some operators climb Gokyo Ri on arrival day and descend next day (11 days). Extensions: Fifth Lake / Ngozumpa glacier viewpoints, Renjo La exit to Thame, or Cho La crossing to EBC (see gokyo-cho-la-everest-base-camp-trek).

start_point: Kathmandu (fly to Lukla, or via Manthali/Ramechhap in peak seasons)

itinerary.route: Acclimatisation day: Hotel Everest View / Khumjung
Namche - Mong La - Phortse Thanga - Dole
itinerary.notes: Leaves the EBC trail; one operator lists Dole at 4,200 m.
Short day for acclimatisation; Cho Oyu views.

itinerary.route: Machhermo - Pangka - first and second lakes - Gokyo
itinerary.notes: Gokyo village on the third lake (Dudh Pokhari), beside the Ngozumpa Glacier.

itinerary.route: Gokyo Ri sunrise (5,357 m); optional walk to fourth/fifth lakes
itinerary.notes: Views of Everest, Lhotse, Makalu and Cho Oyu.
Some itineraries stop at Machhermo instead.
Add a buffer day before international departure.

best_seasons.notes: Same seasonality as Sagarmatha NP generally (NTB). Lakes can freeze in winter.

permits.name: Sagarmatha National Park entry permit
permits.fee: NPR 3,000 per person per entry (SAARC NPR 1,500; under 10 free)

permits.name: Khumbu Pasang Lhamu Rural Municipality Trek-Card
permits.fee: NPR 3,000 per person (SAARC and Chinese nationals NPR 2,000)

guide_requirements: Conflicting. NTB's revised TIMS provision (effective 31 March 2023) lists the Gokyo trek among routes requiring a licensed guide and TIMS card, but Khumbu Pasang Lhamu Rural Municipality rejected the rule in April 2023 and issues its own Trek-Card; operators report independent trekking continues in 2026 (UNVERIFIED enforcement status).

flights: Peak-season diversion via Manthali (Ramechhap): roughly spring Chaitra-Jestha and autumn first week of Ashwin to 15 Mangsir; Manthali-Lukla about 20 min
drives: Kathmandu - Manthali about 4-5 h when Lukla flights are diverted
logistics.notes: Lodges at Dole, Machhermo and Gokyo are simpler than on the EBC trail.

highlights: Gokyo Ri panorama of four 8,000 m peaks (Everest, Lhotse, Makalu, Cho Oyu)
Ngozumpa Glacier, described by operators as the longest glacier in Nepal/Himalaya
Quieter valley than the main EBC trail
risks: Altitude sickness: about 1,350 m sleeping-altitude gain between Namche and Gokyo over three days
Cold and snow on Gokyo Ri in winter

acclimatization.notes: Short day to Machhermo also aids acclimatisation; Gokyo Ri day is a climb-high-sleep-low day at Gokyo.

unverified: Current (2026) enforcement of the national licensed-guide rule in Khumbu.
Dole altitude: most sources 4,040 m, one operator 4,200 m.
Gokyo village altitude: 4,790 m in most sources, 4,750 m in others.
